findings.description: The amendment's list of store writes that skip writeStoreFile leaves out three writes. `pup map --open` writes map.html and `pup report` writes report.html and one dossier HTML per session. All three are at the store root and use plain writeFileSync, which follows a link (src/cli/index.ts:3081-3106).
findings.body:
The amendment is meant to list **every** store write that skips `writeStoreFile` (the PR's acceptance criterion). It says "Three more store writes skip it as well", but three more writes are missing:

- `pup map --open` writes `<store root>/map.html`.
- `pup report` writes `<store root>/report.html`.
- `pup report` also writes one dossier HTML per session (`dossierFileName(session.id)`).

All three use plain `writeFileSync`, which opens with `O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC` and no `O_NOFOLLOW`. A link planted at any of these targets is written through. They are not in the "Writes outside the store" paragraph either: `projectPaths(...).root` is `~/.pupitre/<projectId>` (`src/core/paths.utils.ts:91-92`), which is the store root this ADR defines.

https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/4b82e0c764a0c9bb9dd975090c2555fb0892a40b/src/cli/index.ts#L3081-L3106

A maintainer who reads this ADR will treat the list as complete and won't look for these writes. Add a bullet for them, either as an accepted low or as a gap with a follow-up, and change "Three more" so the count stays right.

findings.description: The amendment leaves out the Bash re-check hook's before-snapshot writes under sessions/<id>/compiled/bash-snapshots (mkdir -p, mktemp -d, mv, rm -f in profile-compiler.service.ts:1144-1261). They skip writeStoreFile, and their mkdir -p follows a link.
findings.body:
The generated Bash re-check hook keeps its before-snapshot under `${outDir}/bash-snapshots`. `outDir` is `sessions/<id>/compiled` (`session-lifecycle.service.ts:519-533`), which this ADR names as a store file location. The hook's writes are:

- `mkdir -p "$SNAPSHOTS" && mktemp -d "$SNAPSHOTS/work.XXXXXX"` (line 1151)
- `mv "$WORK/before" "$SNAPSHOT"` (line 1241)
- `rm -f "$SNAPSHOT"` (line 1261)

None of them goes through `writeStoreFile`. The directory is created at hook time, so `writeCompiledProfile`'s compile-time directory checks don't cover it. `mkdir -p` follows a link planted at `bash-snapshots`.

https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/4b82e0c764a0c9bb9dd975090c2555fb0892a40b/src/core/profile-compiler.service.ts#L1144-L1261

The amendment mentions this script only for its `scope_violation` append. The impact is probably low, because `mv` and `mktemp -d` don't write through a link at the final component. Still, the list is meant to be exhaustive. Add this write next to the `statusline.sh` entry, likely as an accepted low.

findings.description: The amendment heading '## Amendment (2026-11-17)' leaves out the PR number. docs/adr/README.md:20 requires a landed decision's amendment to be 'dated, with the PR', and the sibling amendments (e.g. ADR 0196's '## Amendment (2026-11-17, #371)') include it. Use '## Amendment (2026-11-17, #374)'.
